 UFC Qatar’s Dom Mar Fan Discusses Move to City Kickboxing
 Interviews UFC 
 Daniel Vreeland 
 November 20, 2026 
 Dom Mar Fan Credit: Eternal MMA 
 Dom Mar Fan steps into the Octagon Saturday looking to turn things around a bit. After dropping his official UFC debut to Kody Steele, he’s trying to change the tune. However, that isn’t the only thing that he’s changing. After contemplating on what he feels like he needs most in his career, he decided to switch training camps to work with a legend of the sport.
 “I have actually moved gyms… to City Kickboxing in Auckland, which has been a really big move,” Mar Fan explained. “It’s been really, really productive.”
 A big piece of that move was thinking about what he needs, but that decision wasn’t made in isolation. Close friend and recent main event winner Tom Nolan joined him in that quest for something more.
 “So I just kind of decided I needed something different in my career at that point. Tom [Nolan has] also made the move over there,” he said. “And we both kind of decided we needed a little bit more direction and structure behind our training.”
 The move all started with a quick visit across the country. The two fighters looked to get a bit of cross training done when they realized that they had stumbled upon exactly what they were in search of.
 “We had gone for a training trip to City Kickboxing just to train, and it turned out to be exactly what we were talking about that we thought we needed,” Mar Fan said. “So we shipped everything over. I think him and I were both over there within like two weeks, fully moved over. And we’ve been loving it, just training nonstop.”
 Now he’ll look to prove that his move was the right one when he takes on Nikolas Motta at UFC Qatar. He feels that all of the tools in his box will be too much for the American and expects a lot of advantages.
 “I really do think I’m a nightmare of a fight for him. I think I’m made perfectly to deal with Nikolas Motta,” he said. “I think I’ve got a length and reach advantage on him. I also think I’ve got a big grappling advantage on him. I think there’s only a small range where I think he can get a ton done. I think I’ve got a good skill at being able to keep it in whatever range I want in the fight.”
 You can catch that fight with Motta as part of the prelims of UFC Qatar. The fight card gets started at 10am EST this Saturday on Paramount+.
